description: A2 common_mistakes: one observable learning goal through exact review assets; human rubric required.

input.idea: Teach the English phrase 'I agree' to worldwide non-native elementary learners (A2 planning level). After this lesson the learner can agree with a simple suggestion using 'I agree', and avoid the error 'I am agree'. Clearly label that error and show the correction without shaming learners. Include a short natural dialogue about choosing a time to meet. Make exactly 5 slides. Use simple English-first teaching with visual explanation, no mandatory translation. End with one small practice action. CEFR labels are planning guides, not certification.
